items.caption:
"Just one small change?" Here's what to reply, word for word. Save this for the next one.

1. Name it, kindly: "Happy to! That sits outside our agreed scope, so I'll send a quick quote today."
2. Offer two options: add it at your usual rate, or swap it for something already planned.
3. Confirm in writing: "New intro, +1 day, extra fee as quoted. Reply 'approved' and I'll start."

Then send a 1-page change request the same day: what was asked, effort, price, timeline, approve-by date.

Stop it before it starts: count deliverables, add a "not included" list, cap revisions, and put your extra-work rate in the contract.

Send this to a freelancer who always says yes.

items.caption:
Comment IDEA and I'll DM you the free Reel Idea Machine (a Claude skill + PDF guide).

Your best ideas show up on walks, then disappear. Here's how to turn a rambling voice note into a script:

1. Transcribe: record the voice note, get the transcript (phone dictation is fine)
2. Prompt: paste it into Claude: "Turn this voice note into a 30-second reel: hook, 3 beats, CTA. Keep my phrases."
3. Cut: read it aloud and delete anything you wouldn't actually say

They're still your words. Claude just puts them in order.
